definition: going to shops to get things to wear
example: She loves buying clothes at the weekend.
example_ru: Она обожает покупать одежду по выходным.

definition: sleeping in a tent on holiday
example: We go camping in the mountains every summer.
example_ru: Каждое лето мы ходим в поход с палатками в горы.

definition: making food
example: My dad does the cooking at home.
example_ru: Дома готовит папа.

definition: riding a bike
example: Cycling is good exercise.
example_ru: Езда на велосипеде — хорошая тренировка.

definition: doing slow exercises for your body and mind
example: I like doing yoga in the morning.
example_ru: Мне нравится заниматься йогой по утрам.

translation: ужин вне дома, поход в ресторан
definition: having a meal in a restaurant
example: Eating out in London is expensive.
example_ru: Ходить в рестораны в Лондоне дорого.

definition: travelling by plane
example: I'm afraid of flying.
example_ru: Я боюсь летать.

definition: walking outside for pleasure
example: We love going for a walk in the park.
example_ru: Мы любим гулять в парке.

definition: going to see a film
example: Going to the cinema is my favourite hobby.
example_ru: Ходить в кино — моё любимое хобби.

definition: making pictures with paint
example: My grandmother is very good at painting.
example_ru: Моя бабушка прекрасно рисует красками.

definition: looking at and understanding books, etc.
example: I love reading before I go to sleep.
example_ru: Я люблю читать перед сном.

definition: moving very fast on your feet as a sport
example: He goes running every morning.
example_ru: Он бегает каждое утро.

definition: going to shops to buy things
example: I don't like shopping in big supermarkets.
example_ru: Я не люблю ходить за покупками в большие супермаркеты.

definition: making music with your voice
example: She enjoys singing in the shower.
example_ru: Ей нравится петь в душе.

definition: resting with your eyes closed
example: On Sundays I spend a lot of time sleeping.
example_ru: По воскресеньям я много сплю.

definition: moving through water as a sport
example: Swimming is good for your back.
example_ru: Плавание полезно для спины.

definition: going to different places
example: Travelling is expensive, but I love it.
example_ru: Путешествовать дорого, но я это обожаю.

definition: looking at TV programmes with many episodes
example: I spend my evenings watching TV series.
example_ru: Вечерами я смотрю сериалы.

definition: an official card that shows you can drive
example: My sister has a driving licence, but she doesn't have a car.
example_ru: У сестры есть права, но нет машины.

definition: a test of the rules of the road
example: I pass the theory test on my first try.
example_ru: Я сдаю теорию с первой попытки.

definition: a driving test in a real car
example: The practical test is on Friday.
example_ru: Экзамен по вождению в пятницу.

definition: a person who teaches people to drive
example: My driving instructor is very patient.
example_ru: Мой инструктор по вождению очень терпеливый.

definition: to do an exam
example: I take a test in English next week.
example_ru: На следующей неделе я сдаю тест по английскому.

definition: to get a good result in an exam
example: I hope I pass my driving test!
example_ru: Надеюсь, я сдам экзамен по вождению!

definition: to not pass an exam
example: Many people fail the test the first time.
example_ru: Многие проваливают экзамен с первого раза.

definition: to have lessons to be able to drive a car
example: I want to learn to drive this year.
example_ru: В этом году я хочу научиться водить.

definition: to make the engine of a car work
example: It's very cold and I can't start the car.
example_ru: Очень холодно, и я не могу завести машину.

definition: a bit afraid or worried
example: I'm always nervous before exams.
example_ru: Я всегда нервничаю перед экзаменами.

definition: you say this when something goes very badly
example: My driving test? Total disaster!
example_ru: Мой экзамен по вождению? Полная катастрофа!

definition: you say this when you have no plans on Monday
example: Let's meet. I'm free on Monday.
example_ru: Давай встретимся. Я свободен в понедельник.

definition: a polite way to say yes
example: Can I open the window? — Yes, of course.
example_ru: Можно открыть окно? — Да, конечно.

definition: very bad or unpleasant
example: The weather is horrible today.
example_ru: Сегодня ужасная погода.

definition: quiet and calm
example: The village is very peaceful.
example_ru: Деревня очень спокойная.

definition: afraid
example: The little boy is frightened of the dog.
example_ru: Маленький мальчик боится собаки.

definition: without other people
example: I live alone in a small flat.
example_ru: Я живу один в маленькой квартире.

definition: at events where people meet to have fun
example: He always dances at parties.
example_ru: Он всегда танцует на вечеринках.

definition: to think carefully about one thing
example: I can't concentrate with this music.
example_ru: Я не могу сосредоточиться под эту музыку.

definition: making a lot of noise
example: Our neighbours play music very loudly.
example_ru: Наши соседи включают музыку очень громко.
